summaries.zh: 《F1.com》分析了卡塔尔大奖赛首日的情况，探讨梅赛德斯是否是当前夺冠的最大热门。文章回顾了各车队的初步表现和赛车状态，但未提供具体数据或明确结论。整体评估显示，梅赛德斯在首战中展现出一定优势，但仍需进一步观察其他车队的后续表现。
summaries.en: Mercedes dominated the first day of the Qatar Grand Prix, with drivers Lewis Hamilton and George Russell setting the fastest times. The team showcased strong performance, indicating a strong contender status for the race. F1.com analyzed the early results, highlighting Mercedes' early lead. The article focuses on the team's current form and potential dominance in the upcoming race.

items.title: 'It's never nice' – Gasly explains dramatic FP2 spin

summaries.zh: 奥迪在意大利大奖赛中针对片寄凉太判罚的申诉于11月25日在国际上诉法庭听证后被驳回。
summaries.en: Audi's appeal against Yuki Tsunoda's decision at the Italian GP has been dismissed by the International Court of Appeal on November 25. The court upheld the original ruling, confirming Tsunoda's position. No further details were provided about the hearing's specifics or reasons for the dismissal.
